scenes.summary: You approach the suspicious Tianshi named Bao. Turns out, he's searching for a treasure his grandpa left somewhere nearby. You decide to help him drain the pond water.

lines.text: How strange... The coordinates match perfectly, but I still can't find it...
Ugh, I'm so close to the final step... I can't give up now!
*Gasp* You scared me!
Wait, I know you! You're the Endministrator of Endfield!
⟦key|My name's Bao, and I'm a Tianshi⟧. I'm not here to steal anything...
Actually, I'm searching for a ⟦key|treasure⟧ left by my grandpa!
*Sigh* Yeah, I'm stuck at the very last step.
This place was a temporary depot set up by HAS when the Tianshi first arrived. It's called ⟦key|Tianjing Courtyard⟧. My grandpa used to work here.
And with his dying breath, he told me a secret ... that he left a precious treasure here!
So I followed his treasure map all the way to this very spot...
Now I'm at the last marker, but all I see is this huge pond!
What? How did I not think of that... Thanks for the enlightenment!
The depot was most likely built underground. But over the years, it got flooded and ended up as nothing but a waste of a pond?
But now here's another problem ... I've never learned how to hold my breath underwater. How am I supposed to dive into this pond?
Whoa! That's gonna save me big time!
Endministrator, since you're so awesome ... whatever the treasure turns out to be, I promise a big reward!
My grandpa said the longer it sits, the more valuable it gets! I'm betting it's some kind of fancy antique. Maybe I'll be rich soon!

options: What shady business are you up to?
Looks like you haven't found it yet.
The answer might be right under your nose.
Endfield's trusty Fluid Pump can help you.
I'll help you drain the pond dry.

scenes.summary: Bao realizes the treasure under the pond is an old batch of brew left by his grandfather, Du Qusheng. While it isn't a fortune, he is grateful for your help nonetheless.

lines.text: So, Endmin, what's it say? Any actual treasure?
Du Qusheng is my grandpa!
Okay... I get what he meant by "the longer it sits, the more valuable it gets"... I was really hoping for some priceless gem!
Fair enough... Grandpa loved his brews, and he even taught me how to tell them apart back then...
I might not have gotten wealthy, but I did fulfill my dream of finding Grandpa's treasure!
Thank you, Endministrator.

options: The treasure is likely a batch of old brew by ⟦key|Du Qusheng⟧.

scenes.summary: Bao's analysis indicates that to open the gate at the bottom of the courtyard, you must first locate three "keys" to activate the three mechanisms in front of it.

lines.text: I'm sure the treasure's behind this gate! But how do we get it open...
Gotta be linked to these three mechanisms by the gate... Let me see what hints this treasure map's hiding...
Looks like we'll need three ⟦key|keys⟧ to activate these mechanisms.
Let's go find them, Endmin!
These three "keys" are scattered across the underground first, second, and third levels.
Aha! There it is!

scenes.summary: Bao's analysis indicates that to open the gate at the bottom of the courtyard, you must first locate three "keys" to activate the three mechanisms in front of it.

lines.text: I'm sure the treasure's behind this gate! But how do we get it open...
Gotta be linked to these three mechanisms by the gate... Let me see what hints this treasure map's hiding...
I get it now! The ⟦key|keys⟧ we picked up earlier are used just for this!
Three mechanisms, three keys! They're scattered across the underground first, second, and third levels.
Let's find the remaining keys, Endmin!

scenes.summary: Bao's analysis indicates that to open the gate at the bottom of the courtyard, you must first locate three "keys" to activate the three mechanisms in front of it. You have now found all the "keys."

lines.text: I'm sure the treasure's behind this gate! But how do we get it open...
Gotta be linked to these three mechanisms by the gate... Let me see what hints this treasure map's hiding...
I get it now! The keys we picked up earlier are used just for this!
The treasure's right within reach! Let's activate the ⟦key|mechanism⟧!
Huh? Why isn't it working?
Could leftover moisture be messing with these mechanisms?
Endmin, let's wait for the water to ⟦key|drain completely⟧ and check again.
